statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent palpitations
The patient has a history of atherosclerotic heart disease of the native coronary artery
The patient has nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency
The symptoms are intermittent in nature
Long-term continuous ECG monitoring (CPT 93247) was billed
The claim was denied under reason code CO-22
The denial reason is that coverage may be provided by another insurer pursuant to coordination of benefits protocols
Prairie State Medicaid determined that another plan holds primary responsibility for this expense
